The Subtask Name: Final Comparison and Conclusion
Step Range: 15-15
The Oracle: Compare the retrieved birth years (1888 vs 1964) to determine who was born first and declare the task complete.
Evidence: Planner analyzes the final data, notes 1964 precedes 1888, and outputs the final answer that Fernand Fédronic was born first.
